visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair and silver-rimmed glasses, wearing a grey 'Atzu Garage' hoodie and a necklace with a round pendant, stands in front of a grey building with a blue car parked nearby. He speaks to the camera with high facial arousal, gesturing frequently with his hands. (2) He walks towards a white Mazda 5 parked at the entrance of a garage showroom; the background features various automotive service signs and a grey industrial wall. (3) The man enters the car, sitting in the black leather driver's seat with red stitching, and demonstrates the armrest and the newly installed touchscreen head unit on the dashboard. (4) The scene shifts to him driving the car on an outdoor road with green trees and moving traffic in the background; he looks towards the passenger/camera while steering. (5) A rear view of the white Mazda 5 is shown inside the garage, displaying the license plate 'BZN-5269', followed by more footage of the man driving and explaining car features. (6) Back at the garage, the man stands with two customers—one in a grey-and-black zip-up jacket and another in a dark grey hoodie—near the white Mazda. (7) He hands over the keys to one customer and they both lean into the car to inspect the interior electronics and the sunroof. (8) During a test drive, the man sits in the back seat, observing and talking to the customer who is driving through a suburban area with grey buildings and overcast skies. (9) They return to the garage; the man, now wearing a black face mask under his chin, shakes hands with the customers and they pose for a group photo in front of the car with bright yellow text overlays appearing. (10) The customers depart, and the man stands alone outside the garage, giving a final address to the camera with a confident posture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male voice speaking rapidly with a bright, energetic tone; an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong synthetic beat enters almost immediately. (2) A sharp mechanical click and the hollow thud of a car door closing are heard as the speaker transitions into a descriptive narrative about car interiors. (3) The acoustic texture shifts to include a low-frequency hum of a car engine and the mid-range white noise of tires on asphalt while the host continues his enthusiastic delivery. (4) During the test drive phase, a second male voice with a lower pitch and calmer intonation responds to the host, accompanied by the subtle rustle of clothing. (5) There is a burst of collective laughter from at least three individuals, which functions as an emotional punctuation point in the mix. (6) The BGM remains constant in tempo and volume, providing a rhythmic bed for the overlapping dialogue between the host and two other men. (7) Occasional digital pop and ding sound effects are used to emphasize on-screen text transitions, integrated cleanly into the master track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate the thorough refurbishment and high service standards of used cars sold by 'Atzu Garage', specifically showcasing a white Mazda 5 to build trust with potential buyers by showing the successful delivery to satisfied customers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host explicitly mentions his garage, wears branded clothing, and shows the dealership's signage and successful sales process.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-energy editing and social-media style captions to create a sense of transparency and professionalism in the second-hand car market.
